issue.title: Completed calling turn acknowledgment blocks a ready result behind newer speech
issue.found_on: Focused SIP simulator candidate and controlled scheduler reproduction
issue.symptom: Ready tasks waited 8963–18187 ms; no scripted acknowledgment was spoken. A controlled calling-turn completion remained blocked behind a newer answer.
issue.cause: ackPending is checked before the delivery timeout; the scripted continuation normally waits for the entire conversation floor, even after its own calling playback ended. A delivered repeated request can also leave a covered continuation at the queue head, hiding the next ready task acknowledgment until the global floor clears.
issue.fix: Release the ready task acknowledgment after its own playback completion, preserving function history once. Retain unfinished-clause and scripted-ack guards; prevent result timeout from taking the caller floor during speech, pending ASR finalization or focus hold. Retire only complete continuations wholly covered by the same already-delivered, uncancelled task before checking the next ready acknowledgment. Record their function history exactly once; do not synthesize playback or start another generation.
issue.verified: Both regressions fail on their prior baseline and focused race tests pass. Controlled silent-turn scheduler: 3005 ms on 151b2e3 vs 1503 ms on f8e4d83. Recorded f8e4d83 SIP simulation exercised two silent releases and one playback-completed release; all ready-task waits <=1597 ms, archives verified. Strict 1150 ms gate still fails: content n=9 p95=5180 ms, linked readout n=3 p95=7113 ms, two unverified links and one receiver TTS warning. 151b2e3 full CI passed; f8e4d83 full CI passed. New covered-continuation regression fails on 34ce33f and passes with the fix; running, cancelled, mixed, incomplete, scripted and caller-speaking guards pass. Focused race suite passed (23.006 s). Identical controlled scheduler fixture: baseline 3010 ms vs candidate 1504 ms, with the original 1500 ms delivery wait preserved. Recorded f12b6f5 SIP trial completed with five verified archive files, both audio directions and zero receiver warnings; it did not exercise the new retirement branch. Separate-SLA gate fails: conversational content p95 1105 ms n=4, six unverified result links. All six originating turns lack playback metrics; no fabricated receipts or timing exclusions applied.
issue.effect: Scheduling behavior improved in controlled reproduction and exercised in recorded simulation. No causal real-call speedup or handset qualification established. Cold revised quote task took 5266 ms including 4006 ms upstream service time. Keep issue open; original services and Active Call preserved.

- Call: `sim-coveredack-8d3132ed-a69c-4e8c-bbc4-3a10ce5e8fbe`

- Receiver: `sim-aa20f625e64dfa5f7269ecec`.
- Original GoLive provider profile, saved prompt/greeting/voice and deliberately
  slow quotation service were retained. The same 90-second scenario was used.
- Ended by scenario duration limit; adapter exit 0; all three isolated processes
  exited. Original config hashes and Active Call identity/start are unchanged.

  signal on both channels, 11 assistant and 12 caller transcript entries.
  Receiver warnings: zero.

## Latency and qualification

| Server metric | p95 | Valid samples |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| First audio | 1105 ms | 4 |
| Conversational first content | 1105 ms | 4 |
| Verified linked quotation readout | unavailable | 0 |

The separate quotation policy gate **fails**: six unverified result links and
only four conversational samples (minimum 20). The assumed 50 ms telephony and
handset overhead gives an estimated 1155 ms content p95, not a measured handset
result. The previous diagnostic had 1016 ms with seven conversational samples;
these free-running conversations differ and do not establish a causal speedup.

All six unverified links reference calling turns with no playback metric.
Their result turns do have playback records. Do not invent original playback or
remove these failures to obtain a pass. Future instrumentation must retain the
actual caller-input timing independently of whether the calling turn played.
Two result turns also lack an observed quotation readout; one was truncated and
one had changed memory. Quotation completion is not verified for them.

The run exercised one existing superseded-without-audio acknowledgment release.
It did **not** exercise the new delivered-coalesced-continuation retirement, so
that fix's benefit remains the controlled baseline/candidate result: 3010 to
1504 ms ready-to-delivery with the configured 1500 ms wait unchanged. Ready task
gap waits in this SIP trial were 0, 1514, 3171, 1542 and 0 ms. The 3171 ms wait
requires separate analysis; it is not proof the covered-continuation fix failed.

The revised quote task t3 took 7665 ms. Its API gate wait was 3641 ms and its
API operation 4008 ms, consistent with preserved serialized quotation work.
Receiver application audio gaps were 552, 613, 900, 929 and 1750 ms; they are a
different measurement boundary and are not handset or server-gate samples.

Chat/audio remain in Call Journal on the focused experiment source (port 9916).
No real call was placed and the production call engine was not promoted.
